expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Shanghai shows you where China is going and Xi'an shows you where it came from. Six nights covers both without a long train day.
expert.tip: At the terracotta site, start in Pit One, then walk back through the museum. Going the other way you reach the big pit when it is at its most crowded.

summary: Seven days across two Chinese cities with daily breakfast: the Bund, the Pearl Tower, a Huangpu cruise, Disneyland and the Southern Great Wall in Shanghai, then the terracotta warriors and the walled old centre of Xi'an.
included: Included: 4 nights in Shanghai and 2 nights in Xi'an with daily breakfast; private transfers; half day guided Shanghai city tour; Oriental Pearl Tower tickets; Huangpu river cruise tickets; Shanghai Disneyland tickets; Southern Great Wall day trip; guided Xi'an sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Shanghai to Xi'an internal flight; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
